capabilities: annotate words with hover tooltips using {source/description} syntax
select tooltip styles via default settings or per-tooltip prefixes
format tooltip content with Markdown, links, and note links
edit annotation source inline by placing the cursor in Live Preview
extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop 1.15.0 or later; README states the plugin has no telemetry, ads, accounts, or payments.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach a short note or explanation to a word that appears on hover without breaking the flow of the text.
summary: Inline annotation plugin that adds hover tooltips to words via a {source/description} syntax, with dotted underlines, info icons, speech bubbles, or highlights.
